name: kestrel-desktop
description: Kestrel for Mac: a small window around the live site (https://kestrel.jakecapmeil.workers.dev).

scripts.release: npm run dmg && gh release create mac-v$npm_package_version dist/Kestrel-$npm_package_version-*.dmg --title "Kestrel for Mac $npm_package_version" --notes "Kestrel for Mac $npm_package_version"

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kestrel uses the camera when you photograph a meal for your fuel log.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kestrel uses the microphone when you tap Speak to describe a meal.
